entities.name: YIM1
observations: Exact sequence match to Candida glabrata UniProt Q6FJ26; 368 aa and approximately 41.85 kDa.
Annotated localization includes lipid droplet and mitochondrion.
Associated biological process: DNA damage response.
Pfam matches: ADH_N, ADH_zinc_N, and ADH_zinc_N_2, supporting a zinc-dependent alcohol dehydrogenase-like fold.

entities.name: YIM1 sequence properties
observations: Sequence length is 368 aa; predicted molecular weight is 41848.492 Da; theoretical pI is 8.312; predicted charge at pH 7 is +2.81.
These are sequence-derived estimates and do not account for modifications, ligands, or oligomerization.

entities.name: Lipid droplet
observations: YIM1 is annotated as localized to lipid droplets in curated fungal protein records.

entities.name: Mitochondrion
observations: YIM1 is annotated as localized to mitochondria in curated fungal protein records.

entities.name: DNA damage response
observations: YIM1 is associated with the DNA damage response in curated annotations; the sequence analysis does not establish a direct mechanistic role.
